plan.summary:
Refresh now rejects malformed refresh tokens before it calls the server.

- `refresh` throws `Malformed refresh token` unless the token matches `/^[\w-]{20,}$/`.
- `maskToken` moves lower in `src/auth/tokens.ts`. Its code is unchanged.
plan.riskRationale: The change is in auth token handling. It adds a new rejection path. A valid token with a different format would now fail before the server call. The diff shows no tests.
plan.storyArc: The main change is the new check in `refresh`. The `maskToken` move only reorders the file, so it is noise.

noise.reason: This hunk only removes `maskToken` from the top of the file. Hunk-1 adds it back with identical code.

topics.title: Reject malformed refresh tokens before server call
topics.narrativeBrief: What does `refresh` now check before it calls `fetchTokens`, and which tokens fail? Verify the regex bounds and the thrown error. Also verify that `maskToken` is byte-identical to the removed code.
